newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Yorba Linda sets 4-for-3 split.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Yorba Linda sets 4-for-3 split.

text.p: Bank of Yorba Linda said its board declared a four-for-three stock split and a cash dividend of $0.05 per share on the shares following the stock split.
The stock split will be effective and the cash dividend is payable June 30, 1997 to shareholders of record on June 6, 1997. The Bank will pay cash in lieu of fractional shares.
It also said the board had approved the formation of a bank holding company subject to obtaining regulatory and shareholder approvals.
The company last payed a quarterly dividend of $0.20 on an annualized basis.
